@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+# Dependency refresh — 15 November 2026
+
+This change updates the packaging and Python runtime of my existing master-data reconciliation reference. It does not introduce a new reconciliation algorithm, alter business contracts or run a migration. The maintained Python range stays `>=3.12,<3.13`.
+
+| Component | Prior pin | Selected pin | Source |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| Python Docker / CI | 3.12.14 | 3.12.16 | [Dependabot #7](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/pull/7), [Python security release](https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-31216/) |
+| FastAPI | 0.141.1 | 0.162.4 | [Dependabot #4](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/pull/4), [release notes](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/) |
+| Pydantic | 2.13.4 | 2.14.3 | [Dependabot #5](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/pull/5) |
+| Pydantic Core | 2.46.4 | 2.50.4 | Transitive pin from #5 |
+| Hatchling | 1.29.0 | 1.33.0 | [Dependabot #6](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/pull/6), [changelog](https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/) |
+
+## Lockfile construction
+
+The complete FastAPI package block comes from PR #4; the complete Pydantic and Pydantic Core blocks come from PR #5. Both direct dependency specifiers are updated in the locked root-project metadata. All other package blocks come unchanged from the qualified main lock. Hatchling remains a build-system requirement outside the application lock. No package checksums, URLs or compatibility claims were invented. The builder/runtime Docker tags, GitHub Actions Python selection and operating documentation now agree.
+
+## Verification status
+
+Previous committed original evidence is under [evidence](../evidence/README.md). The full 14 November Python/PostgreSQL, dbt, HTTP, restore and audit results apply to the **previous** executable source and dependency lock. A prior isolated continuation reported additional checks, but its unpublished original files are not present in this GitHub revision; these claims are not promoted to retained evidence for this change.
+
+To qualify the new head:
+
+1. Run `uv sync --locked --all-extras` with Python 3.12.16 and uv 0.13.6; build and test the sdist, wheel and editable install.
+2. Run `uv run --no-sync pytest -q` against the dedicated real PostgreSQL test DB; execute the synthetic business demonstration, dbt build/catalog, HTTP checks, backup/restore and post-restore tests.
+3. Execute the bounded load and retrieve the current dependency advisory, component and license inventory. Preserve raw output, inputs, source SHA, versions and any nonzero exit.
+4. Run the container/rendered-browser and Terraform provider-schema profiles on an actually allocated runner. A successful Dependabot service job or empty Actions job does not pass them.
+5. Qualify Snowflake publication, readback, rollback and dbt parity only with an explicitly authorized account/role/warehouse, cost cap and source-linked evidence.
+
+No updated-runtime test is called successful merely from these edits. Full acceptance remains open in [issue #1](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/issues/1); the repository's public visibility and project licence are separate maintainer decisions.
+
+## Rollback
+
+Revert the dependency-refresh commit and deploy the previously qualified application build, subject to the usual source/schema/outbox compatibility checks. A dependency rollback does not reverse already-consumed business events; the existing correction and consumer-reconciliation processes remain authoritative.

+"""Smoke contracts for upgrades to Python, Pydantic and FastAPI; no database required."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import tomllib
+from importlib.metadata import version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+from mdm.api import (
+    IngestInput, MergeInput, PreviewInput, SplitInput, UnmergeInput, VersionInput,
+    create_app,
+)
+from mdm.config import Actor
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("distribution", ["fastapi", "uvicorn", "pydantic", "psycopg"])
+def test_installed_runtime_distributions_match_direct_pins(distribution):
+    data = tomllib.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "pyproject.toml").read_text())
+    pins = {}
+    for requirement in data["project"]["dependencies"]:
+        name, sep, exact_version = requirement.partition("==")
+        assert sep and exact_version and ";" not in exact_version, requirement
+        pins[name.split("[")[0]] = exact_version
+    assert version(distribution) == pins[distribution]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("model", "data"), [
+    (MergeInput, {"group_ids": ["g1", "g2"], "expected_versions": {"g1": 1, "g2": 1},
+                  "reason": "unit", "idempotency_key": "test-merge"}),
+    (PreviewInput, {"group_ids": ["g1", "g2"]}),
+    (SplitInput, {"group_id": "g1", "partitions": [["a"], ["b"]], "expected_version": 1,
+                  "reason": "unit", "idempotency_key": "test-split"}),
+    (UnmergeInput, {"merge_decision_id": "m1", "expected_versions": {"g1": 1},
+                    "reason": "unit", "idempotency_key": "test-unmerge"}),
+    (VersionInput, {"expected_version": 1}),
+    (IngestInput, {"records": []}),
+])
+def test_pydantic_inputs_preserve_strict_unknown_field_rejection(model, data):
+    assert model.model_validate(data).model_dump(exclude_none=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        model.model_validate({**data, "unreviewed_field": "must be refused"})
+
+
+def test_authentic_openapi_is_bearer_protected_and_preserves_domain_routes():
+    token = "unit-only-contract-token"
+    client = TestClient(create_app(actor_map={token: Actor("unit-reader", "reader")}))
+    assert client.get("/api/openapi.json").status_code == 401
+    response = client.get("/api/openapi.json", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    for path in ("/api/decisions/merge", "/api/decisions/split", "/api/decisions/unmerge",
+                 "/api/preview-merge", "/api/ingest"):
+        assert path in response.json()["paths"]
+    assert client.get("/openapi.json").status_code == 404

pull_request.title: build: consolidate Python 3.12 and application dependency updates
pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Consolidate four compatible Dependabot proposals against the already integrated enterprise MDM reference. This keeps the existing `>=3.12,<3.13` runtime contract and avoids independently merging overlapping `uv.lock` edits.

## Changes

- Python Docker builder/runtime and GitHub Actions: **3.12.14 → 3.12.16** (#7).
- FastAPI **0.141.1 → 0.162.4** (#4), Pydantic **2.13.4 → 2.14.3** and Core **2.46.4 → 2.50.4** (#5).
- Hatchling build backend **1.29.0 → 1.33.0** (#6).
- Combined the exact upstream Dependabot package blocks and direct root constraints; 122 locked package identities remain, and unrelated blocks are untouched.
- Added dependency/runtime compatibility smoke tests and aligned the README, CI runtime, operating runbook, verification, acceptance, publication and release notes.

## Reviewed and observed

- Candidate branch is one commit ahead of the exact original `main` SHA `16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fb...`; diff/readback lists **12 changed files**, including the exact merged lock.
- The code and published documentation explicitly retain the **14 November native PostgreSQL/dbt/HTTP evidence** as historical evidence for its original dependency lock. Those old results **do not** count as a pass for this new source.
- No domain-model change, SQL migration, Snowflake deployment, repo licence, visibility update or external service change.

## Open verification gates

- Run `uv sync --locked --all-extras`, the full real-PostgreSQL pytest suite, wheel/sdist checks, native HTTP, dbt/restore, component/advisory inventory and container/browser/Terraform jobs at the new head; preserve original logs and hashes. These actions are **not asserted as executed in this PR**.
- GitHub Actions application runner admission and live Snowflake remain separate open gates. No unassigned Actions job is a pass.
- Merge this rollup only after its diff and verification limitations are consciously reviewed. Close #4–#7 as superseded only after the combined change is integrated.

Tracking: #1. Documentation: `docs/dependency-refresh-2026-11-15.md`. This is maintainer-agent self-review, not an independent approval.

issue1.title: Deliver explainable and reversible industrial master data reconciliation
issue1.body:
## Outcome

Build a working master-data reconciliation platform for a fictitious industrial group with three ERP systems. The first integrated delivery must ingest immutable originals, explain candidate matches, support human approval, publish attribute-level provenance, and correct a mistaken merge without losing source identities.

## Inventory

Inspected on 2026-11-13: the repository is private and empty, with no branches, issues or pull requests. There is no existing code or licence to preserve. This issue records the scope before implementation. Only this repository and isolated execution environments are in scope.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Versioned source, matching, survivorship, decision and output contracts; validated configuration and identifiers.
- [x] Three synthetic ERPs; positive, negative and held-out truth; legal entities, establishments and roles distinguished.
- [x] Measured candidate recall, pair precision/recall, review burden and group correctness; bridge merges blocked.
- [ ] Human review, distinct requester/approver/executor, optimistic versions, merge/split/unmerge and stable source crosswalks. Server workflows are qualified; rendered-console verification remains open.
- [x] Attribute lineage, authority-before-recency survivorship, bitemporal late corrections and non-overlapping history.
- [x] Transactional outbox, idempotent consumer, consumer correction after split and crash recovery.
- [x] Real PostgreSQL integration tests and dbt build artifacts; repeat ingestion, stale decisions, unavailable source, event duplication and recovery exercised.
- [ ] Container reference deployment, locked dependencies, CI, observability, backup and exercised restore.
- [ ] Snowflake adapter and infrastructure reviewed, followed by an authorized live Snowflake/dbt qualification.
- [ ] Repository release review, explicit licence choice, metadata/protections within available permissions and public visibility only if separately authorized.

## Prioritized delivery

1. **P0 — Integrated reference:** domain contracts, synthetic truth, matching, durable PostgreSQL service, API/review console and executable scenario.
2. **P0 — Correctness:** lifecycle/concurrency/failure tests, genuine dbt build, evidence and restore drill.
3. **P1 — Target integration:** Snowflake snapshot publication, dbt parity, bounded Terraform configuration and live qualification.
4. **P1 — Operation and release:** deployment, runbooks, CI checks, measured bounded load, release candidate notes and complete acceptance matrix.

## Constraints and open prerequisites

The maintainer requested public source publication on 14 November and will perform the repository-setting changes in GitHub's interface. No repository licence has been approved; no licence grant will be added implicitly. A dedicated authorized Snowflake account, role, warehouse/database scope and spend cap are needed for live Snowflake qualification. Static Terraform schema checks need a compatible runner but no warehouse credentials. Local PostgreSQL success will not be recorded as Snowflake validation. Reviews performed by the implementation agents are self-review, not independent approval.

## Delivery update — 2026-11-14 UTC

**Source integration is complete.** PR #2 merged into `main` at [`e27f4c2f`](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/commit/e27f4c2f58d812a2213b1457378095dc72dafd8a). The final [delivery consolidation `16f7325c`](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/commit/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7) follows that merge, with complete tree `bcc83ae57e77f0081dbfbd276ddd6108ec5ee1d2` equal to the reviewed local tree. The main README and Dependabot configuration were read back byte-for-byte.

At the latest API readback the repository remained private and About metadata unset. The maintainer owns those interface changes under the explicit Public objective. Full project acceptance remains open in this issue; no release tag or repository licence was selected.

- [Original evidence and source correspondence](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/evidence/README.md)
- [Acceptance matrix](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/docs/acceptance.md)
- [Release candidate notes](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/docs/releases/0.1.0rc1.md)
- [Publication procedure and exact About metadata](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/docs/publication.md)

### Supported qualification

**125 tests and 15 subtests passed with zero skips, including 53 real PostgreSQL cases.** Thirteen added regressions cover bounded publication completion/recovery, historical incompatibility and stale group disposition. Application, test, dbt, dependency and Docker inputs remain identical to qualified source `205e7507b9cd7dc1b34a858f2c524ce0c832642c`.

The actual PostgreSQL 17.12 flow passed all seventeen phases. Its business scenario passed six assertions and nine invariants, with 34 retained source identities, 28 active golden records and 34 aligned reporting mappings. Five dbt models and 41 data tests passed; a populated catalog was generated. Native backup/restore preserved seventeen table fingerprints, rejected the populated target for the exact intended reason, and passed 41 restored dbt tests.

The live HTTP server passed 24 requests and 127 assertions for auth, assets, provenance, metrics and correlation, with verified shutdown and secret cleanup. A 300-source profile measured ingestion, consolidation, SQL plan and history growth; these are limited synthetic measurements.

The [targeted evidence-control qualification](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/evidence/2026-11-14/ci-evidence-hardening/qualification.json) subsequently passed 41 dbt tests again, preserved build output through docs generation, accepted the intended restore refusal and rejected two actual unrelated failures. Both databases' seventeen operational table fingerprints were unchanged. Fifty-two originals are preserved. The equivalent Snowflake helper fix is syntax-checked, not live-qualified. No new full runtime suite was run for the final documentation/Dependabot-policy changes.

### Publication checks and automation

The [expanded history capture](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/blob/16f7325c5f8b16ce2c5259d2fba44f40e78bebe7/evidence/2026-11-14/publication-preflight/post-merge-history/remote-history-scan.json) records five listed branches plus closed PR #3's head at 14:22 UTC: 16 commits, 15 complete trees, 540 hash-verified blobs and 11,065,653 bytes. No configured pattern or limited input was reported in that scope; 23 older/remote blobs were fetched to complete it. Tags, unreachable objects and inaccessible account/log data remain excluded.

The final working-tree scan covers 561 files and 517 local-history blobs, with no detected pattern or limited input before its own report was copied. Static consolidation checks cover 192 relative links, metadata, the Python contract and four new preserved originals. These checks are scoped evidence, not exhaustive secret detection.

Three initial Dependabot service jobs succeeded with 18 steps in total. Application/Terraform qualification remains distinct. Python 3.15 PR #3 was closed without merging because the project supports Python 3.12; the published update policy ignores major/minor Python Docker updates while retaining patch eligibility. PRs #4–#6 for FastAPI, Pydantic and Hatchling remain open and unmerged. The verified lock is unchanged.

### Remaining concrete gates

1. **Application CI/container/browser/provider schema:** final-head [Quality run 43605050912](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/actions/runs/43605050912) has a failed scope job with runner 0 and no steps, skipped dependent jobs and zero artifacts. The merged-reference [Terraform run 43603763082](https://github.com/mehdisafer/enterprise-master-data-reconciliation/actions/runs/43603763082) also has no executed steps. Exact admission text remains unread; no billing/quota/policy cause is established. Native TCP qualification does not qualify Docker, rendered Chromium or the provider schema. Terraform schema validation needs a compatible runner, not Snowflake credentials.
2. **Snowflake:** provide a dedicated authorized account/role, key-pair credential, database/warehouse scope and explicit budget, then execute live publication/readback/rollback, dbt parity and accessible timing/cost evidence.
3. **Public access and administration:** apply Public and About metadata through the maintainer's GitHub interface, then verify anonymous repository/README access and metadata. Main integration is already verified. Available protections and any future licence grant remain separate explicit decisions.

Issue #1 stays open. The unchecked criteria retain their remaining rendered deployment, provider and release scope. No full-runtime acceptance, paid-plan change, live warehouse deployment or independent approval is asserted. Last delivery/API consolidation: 2026-11-14 14:30:27 UTC.

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+# Manual Docker/HTTP/browser qualification. PostgreSQL/dbt/restore and Terraform
+# retain their separate full workflows; this does not claim Snowflake acceptance.
+version: 2.1
+jobs:
+  reference-containers:
+    machine:
+      image: ubuntu-2404:2026.10.1
+    resource_class: large
+    environment:
+      DBT_SEND_ANONYMOUS_USAGE_STATS: "false"
+      DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"
+    steps:
+      - checkout
+      - run:
+          name: Record source and scope an isolated reference deployment
+          command: |
+            mkdir -p artifacts
+            git rev-parse HEAD > artifacts/commit.txt
+            docker version > artifacts/docker-version.txt
+            docker compose version > artifacts/compose-version.txt
+            printf 'export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=mdm-ci-%s\n' "$CIRCLE_WORKFLOW_ID" >> "$BASH_ENV"
+            printf 'export MDM_SECRET_DIR=.secrets/ci-%s\n' "$CIRCLE_WORKFLOW_ID" >> "$BASH_ENV"
+            python3 -m venv /tmp/mdm-ci-tools
+            /tmp/mdm-ci-tools/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check uv==0.13.6
+            printf 'export PATH=/tmp/mdm-ci-tools/bin:$PATH\n' >> "$BASH_ENV"
+      - run:
+          name: Install the reviewed browser qualification environment
+          command: |
+            uv sync --frozen --extra browser --python 3.12.14
+            uv run --no-sync python --version
+            uv run --no-sync python -m playwright install --with-deps --only-shell chromium
+      - run:
+          name: Prepare ephemeral identities and build the reference image
+          no_output_timeout: 20m
+          command: |
+            python3 .github/scripts/setup_ci_secrets.py
+            docker compose config --quiet
+            printf '%s\n' "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" > artifacts/owned-compose-project.txt
+            docker compose build
+      - run:
+          name: Start PostgreSQL, migrations and API with health checks
+          command: docker compose up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 120 api
+      - run:
+          name: Execute the image and verify the host-facing API
+          command: |
+            docker compose exec -T api mdm demo > artifacts/container-demo.json
+            docker compose exec -T api mdm check > artifacts/container-check.json
+            curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz > artifacts/container-health.json
+            docker compose images --format json > artifacts/container-images.json
+      - run:
+          name: Exercise the actual rendered review and consumer views
+          command: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 180s uv run --no-sync python scripts/browser_smoke.py
+      - run:
+          name: Retain diagnostics and remove only this synthetic deployment
+          when: always
+          command: |
+            mkdir -p artifacts
+            if test -f artifacts/owned-compose-project.txt &&
+               test "$(cat artifacts/owned-compose-project.txt)" = "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME"; then
+              docker compose logs --no-color > artifacts/container.log 2>&1 || true
+              docker compose ps --all --format json > artifacts/container-state.json || true
+              docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans --timeout 30
+            fi
+      - store_artifacts:
+          path: artifacts
+          destination: reference
+workflows:
+  reference-qualification:
+    jobs:
+      - reference-containers
